Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::createCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingCashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isNew: Boolean = existingCashier.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		existingCashier.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newCashier: Cashier in
		newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Cashiers->includes(newCashier)) and
		result = isNew
}
